stop_hook_instruction.description:
Instruction returned by the Stop hook when it blocks a session.
Codex sessions use this instruction unless Codex status inference is
enabled; Claude sessions use it when status inference is not configured.
At least one status must be configured.

vibe_marker.description: Marker shown after the name of a session running in vibe mode.

work_type_fallback.description: Display configuration used in `a agent watch` when a session has no recorded work type.

work_types.description: Display configuration for agent work types, keyed by skill name.

worktree.description: Worktree settings used by `a agent` and worktree cleanup commands.

AgentLaunchEngineConfig.description: Per-engine defaults selected by an `agent.launch_profiles` entry.

model.description: Model passed to the selected engine when `--model` is omitted.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort used when `--reasoning-effort` is omitted.

engine.description: Engine selected when `a agent new --engine` is omitted.

engine.description: Coding agent CLI used for this type.

model.description: Model passed to the selected engine.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort used for this type.

AgentStatusConfig.description: Configuration for one user-defined agent status name.

AgentStatusState.description: Meaning assigned to a configured agent status name.

AgentWorkTypeColor.description: A terminal color accepted for an agent watch marker.

AgentWorkTypeConfig.description: Display settings for an agent watch marker.

icon.description: Icon shown in the agent watch marker.

AgentWorkTypeNamedColor.description: A named terminal color accepted for an agent watch marker.

AiConfig.description: Settings under the `ai` key (used in both org and repo scopes).

reviewers.description:
Default reviewers for `a ai review wait` and `a ai review request`.
`None` means "fall back to the next layer" (org -> built-in default).

AutoCompactConfig.description:
Configuration for automatically running `/compact` against sessions that
have been idle for `idle_timeout` while the prompt cache is still warm.

The Stop hook spawns a detached `a agent auto-compact schedule` process for
each Stop event. After `idle_timeout` of inactivity (anchored on the Stop
hook fire time), it SIGTERMs the live `claude` process and then re-runs
`claude -r <id> -p "/compact"` so that the compaction itself benefits from
the still-warm prompt cache.

enabled.description: Whether automatic compaction is enabled (default: true).

idle_timeout.description:
How long a session must stay idle (since the last Stop hook) before
auto-compact fires. Should be slightly less than the prompt cache TTL
so the resulting `/compact` invocation hits a warm cache (Claude Code
subscriptions: 5m TTL → default 4m30s).

min_context_tokens.description:
Minimum context size (in tokens) required before auto-compact fires.
Sessions whose latest assistant turn shows a smaller prompt than this
are skipped — compacting a tiny context wastes a turn and discards
useful state for no benefit. Measured against
`input + cache_read + cache_creation + output` of the most recent
assistant entry in the transcript, so it tracks the actual prompt the
next turn would send regardless of which model context window is in
use (200k vs 1M).
Default: 180000.

AutoPauseConfig.description:
Configuration for automatically pausing sessions that stay in the Stopped
state for longer than `timeout`.

A periodic `a agent sweep` run (typically driven by launchd) scans all sessions,
requests shutdown of any agent process whose session has been Stopped for
longer than `timeout`, and flips the session status to Paused so that
`a agent resume` can restore it later.

enabled.description: Whether automatic pausing is enabled (default: true).

timeout.description:
How long a session must stay in Stopped before being paused.
Accepts human-friendly durations parsed by the `humantime` style parser
built into armyknife, e.g., "30s", "10m", "1h30m".
Default: "30m".

BgTaskReminderConfig.description: Configuration for reminders sent when a background task exceeds its timeout.

excluded_commands.description: Command fragments that skip reminders when they appear in the command line.

message.description: Message sent when a background task exceeds `timeout`.
message.default: This is a reminder, not an error: this background task has been running for a long time. Check its output and the state of what it is monitoring. Stop it if it is stuck.

timeout.description:
How long a background task may run before a reminder is sent.
Accepts human-friendly durations such as "13m". When omitted, reminders are disabled.

CodexConfig.description:
Per-invocation `codex` defaults. Passed on the command line rather than
written to `~/.codex/config.toml`, so a hand-run `codex` is unaffected.

model.description: Model passed to `codex --model` when `--model` is omitted.

reasoning_effort.description:
Effort applied to the launched Codex session when `--reasoning-effort`
is omitted.

CodexStatusInferenceConfig.description: Opt-in settings for inferring Codex Stop status from saved conversation history.

background_status.description: Status recorded while armyknife background work is still pending.

enabled.description: Enable Codex Stop inference. When enabled, failure and background statuses are required.

failure_status.description: Status recorded if snapshot acquisition, classification, validation, or worker startup fails.

shadow_mode.description: Log classifications without writing any status to the session database.

focus_app.description:
App name to focus on notification click (macOS only).
If omitted, derived from the terminal setting.

Engine.description:
Which coding agent CLI hosts a session. Determines the process name to
look for in a tmux pane, and which binary/subcommand `a agent new` /
`a agent resume` launch. Defaults to `Claude` (`#[serde(default)]` on
`Session::engine`) so stored session records predating this field, and
hook invocations that don't pass `--engine`, keep behaving exactly as
before Codex support existed.

LayoutNode.description: Layout tree node: either a single pane (leaf) or a split (internal node).

sound.description: Notification sound name (default: "Glass"). Empty string for silent.

ai.description: AI-related per-org defaults (e.g., reviewer set for `a ai review wait`).

vibe.description: Whether vibe mode is allowed for repositories owned by this organization (default: false).

PaneConfig.description: Configuration for a single tmux pane.

command.description: Command to run in the pane.

focus.description: Whether to focus this pane (default: false).

ReasoningEffort.description:
Effort levels accepted by both `claude --effort` and Codex `turn/start`.
A closed set so a typo is rejected
at parse time instead of reaching the CLI, which would silently fall back to
its default effort.

ai.description: AI-related per-repo overrides (e.g., reviewer set for `a ai review wait`).

direct_commit.description:
Whether direct commits to the default branch (e.g., master/main) are allowed.
Consumed by external git hooks; armyknife only stores and exposes the value.

language.description: Language for commit messages and PR content (e.g., "ja", "en").

vibe.description: Whether vibe mode is allowed for this repository. When omitted, the org setting applies.

SplitConfig.description: Split configuration with direction and two child nodes.

first.description: First child (left for horizontal, top for vertical).

second.description: Second child (right for horizontal, bottom for vertical).

StatusInferenceStatusConfig.description:
Status written when Codex status inference cannot be started or completed,
or when the Stop hook observes background work.

note.description: One-line explanation stored with the inferred status.

Terminal.description: Terminal emulator to use for human-in-the-loop reviews.

repos_root.description:
Root directory containing git repositories.
Used by `a agent clean --all` to discover repositories.
Falls back to GHQ_ROOT env, git config ghq.root, or ~/ghq.
